title: 1,000 Original Engineering Case Competition Simulations
description: Synthetic hypothetical engineering cases for education, not historical winning solutions or validated engineering designs.

cases.case_title: Factory bottleneck redesign — Baseline improvement
cases.case_brief: Factory bottleneck redesign at a hypothetical regional engineering organization. Standard operations with predictable demand. The present current daily output is 1,042.83 units/day.
cases.decision_question: Which design or operational change should be selected for factory bottleneck redesign, and why does it outperform alternatives under the stated conditions?
cases.objective: Create an implementable engineering proposal achieving target output improvement of 20.7 %, while preserving safety, service and regulatory compliance.
constraints: Capital budget <= CAD 1,625,000
Finish core implementation within 12 months
Use only the provided facts; explain assumptions and show one quantitative comparison.
Do not sacrifice regulatory compliance or operational safety
Standard operations with predictable demand.

solution_model.approach: Diagnose baseline and constraints; apply discrete-event simulation + theory of constraints; test three options; quantify capital/operating costs, performance, safety and emissions; conduct sensitivity analysis; recommend staged pilot with measurable gates.
recommended_workflow: Estimate expected performance and total lifecycle costs
Select option via explicit weighted decision criteria
Plan pilot, commissioning, and go/no-go gates
solution_model.caution: No unique numeric solution is implied by this brief. Learners must request additional assumptions/data and defend a credible recommendation.

judge_questions: What is the most sensitive assumption in your discrete-event simulation + theory of constraints model, and what would make you reject the chosen option?
Which stakeholder carries the greatest implementation risk?
How would your recommendation change if the budget were cut another 20%?
What field test would falsify your main hypothesis?
cases.data_quality: Synthetic illustrative input; independently verify before any real engineering use
